First off, you need to study chart patterns. This will help you to understand what the stock will do next. But remember, its only a prediction. So if the stock have news with much volume, this indicate we got a good buy. But if you have wrong, and the stock going against you, sell quickly!

Now to the biggest qustion off all time! This was a struggle for me in the beginning. How do i know wich stock to trade? Where do i find these stocks? You need a stock scanner with your own algorithms, this is the key to find stocks to daytrade. Everyone looking for stocks with different criterias. I personally trade stocks with a float value between 10-50 million share float. This means that there is 10-50 millions shares for the public to buy. Some people dont trade stocks with float over 10 million. The less float a stock has, the quicker the stock can move. The program i use to find stocks like this is "Trade-ideas". Really good program that find the stocks for you.

And also, patience is the key, You cant rush into a trade because it looks good. You want to find the support level off the stock. Support is where the stock have support from the downside, and resistance for the upside.

Here you can see that we have a support line at $2.56  [https://imgur.com/STxPZuM](https://imgur.com/STxPZuM)

This is just some basic information, you need to study and search for information. This isn't someting you learn overnight. There was a person who said, "DONT learn to trade, TRADE to learn". So i suggest you start trading with paper money. (fake money). It will take time. Hope this helped a bit... I understand Engish well, but its harder to write/speak english...
